Team — reviewed VentureLane_Redlines_v2.docx and redline_summary.xlsx attached. Short summary and recommendation: 

- Liability cap: They request $10M (our standard is $2M / 2x ARR capped). Given deal size (~$1.2M ARR estimate on first year) this is outside delegated authority. Recommended concession: increase to $5M with a carve-out for willful misconduct (no change). Any increase above $5M requires EVP/CEO approval.

- Indemnity: They broaden IP indemnity to include third-party claims plus a reverse indemnity for their subcontractors. We can agree to indemnify for confirmed Redwood-originated IP infringement but must exclude general third-party business claims and limit obligation to our indemnity insurers' coverage amount. Proposed language: (i) Redwood indemnifies for IP claims to the extent caused by our models/services; (ii) for all other third-party claims, liability remains limited by the cap.

- Warranty language: They want removal of ‘AS IS’ for certain performance metrics. We can accept a narrowly tailored service-level warranty for availability (SLA) tied to credits, but must preserve broad disclaimers for model outputs (no guarantees on hallucination/content accuracy).

- Termination/notice: Their shortened notice harms our ability to remediate; recommend keeping standard 60-day cure period, allow limited termination for persistent SLA breaches.

Implications: Accepting their full position increases downstream risk and insurance exposure. If sales wants to proceed with $5M cap and the indemnity language above, I can prepare a clean redline and summary for exec approval. Anything above $5M or removal of key warranty/disclaimer language — needs Evelyn or CEO sign-off.

Attachments: redline_summary.xlsx (legal analysis)

- Laura
General Counsel | Redwood Inference

Quick commercial note: VentureLane is strategic in fintech space and could be a reference account. Pipeline shows ~$1.2M ARR Year 1, growing to ~3.8M in Y3. If we do $5M cap + indemnity carveouts per Laura, I can offer a one-time implementation credit of up to 12% of first-year committed spend and a 6-month SLA ramp (reduced credits in ramp period).

If LAURA insists on keeping limit at $2M, we lose leverage and likely slow the deal. If Evelyn can approve elevation to $5M cap + 12% credit, we can close this quarter. Anything above $5M, I need explicit exec approval for both liability and incremental commercial concession (I estimate up to 20% total cash/credit impact at $10M cap).

— Karthik
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — read Laura’s analysis and Karthik’s commercial plan. I will approve the following as an exec exception so you can move to final: 

1) Increase liability cap to $5M (one-time exception).
2) Accept the indemnity language Laura proposed (Redwood indemnifies for Redwood-originated IP infringement; other third-party claims limited by cap and insurer coverage).
3) Warranty: accept narrow SLA warranty for availability tied to credits; explicitly preserve disclaimer for model outputs.
4) Commercial concession: up to 12% one-time implementation credit as Karthik proposed.

Conditions: legal to prepare final redline and a short exec memo capturing risk/mitigation; sales must secure a signed SOW within 14 days and record the concession in HubSpot (deal_id DL-2026-043). Any request to go above $5M or to change warranty/disclaimer scope further goes to CEO.

Beth — thanks for the redlines and the patience while we reviewed internally. We are aligned to proceed with the following commercial/legal package: 

• Liability cap: Redwood will increase the cap to $5,000,000 (one-time executive exception).
• Indemnity: Redwood will provide IP indemnity for confirmed Redwood-originated IP infringement. Other third-party claims will remain subject to the liability cap and our insurance coverage.
• Warranty/SLA: We will add a narrow SLA warranty for availability and associated credits. We will retain the broader disclaimers around model outputs and accuracy.
• Commercial concession: Redwood will provide a one-time implementation credit equal to 12% of Year 1 committed spend, conditional on execution of the SOW within 14 days.

Laura will send a clean redline to both legal teams and a short memo summarizing the risk and the exec exception. Once you confirm acceptance of these points I’ll send the updated SOW and DocuSign link for signature.
